reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to go. My doctor only said it could be low, and I'd rather get that confirmed with a blood test than buy a supplement off TikTok.
objection: I don't have a use for the to-go part. I'm home every night, and a regular bottle of magnesium costs less per day than $0.83.
would_change_my_mind: A blood test showing my magnesium is low and my doctor naming this kind of magnesium, or a much lower price per day than my bottle.
